actions.action: Keep confirmation bound to the reviewed slot
actions.mechanism: Separate the selected slot’s identity from live capacity, so refreshes cannot silently substitute another booking.
actions.implementation: Store the slot ID and reviewed details; submit that ID to the existing atomic endpoint. Label selection as unreserved; require review if details change.
actions.check: Invalidate or reorder slots between selection and confirmation; verify no different slot is submitted and conflicts produce an explicit unavailable state.
actions.risk: Displayed capacity can still become stale before confirmation.

actions.mechanism: Treat unavailability as a recoverable selection failure, preserving the person’s search context rather than restarting booking.
actions.implementation: Retain workshop, week, filters, and failed selection. Offer explicitly selectable alternatives with differences stated; never automatically select or confirm replacements.
actions.check: Force a confirmation conflict; verify preferences survive and keyboard users can review and explicitly confirm an alternative at 320 pixels.
actions.risk: Alternatives may also become unavailable; describe them without guarantees.

actions.action: Keep controls stable during capacity refreshes
actions.mechanism: Update availability in place without moving focused controls, reducing repeated targeting while someone reaches confirmation.
actions.implementation: Keep slot order and focused elements stable; use a single-column 320-pixel layout, keyboard-operable controls, and a persistent confirmation region. Announce selected-slot changes politely.
actions.check: Refresh repeatedly during keyboard and pointer navigation; verify unchanged focus, no refresh-driven target movement, no horizontal scrolling, and no automatic submission.
actions.risk: Frequent announcements can overwhelm; suppress duplicates and unrelated updates.

actions.action: Measure conflicts and recovery without speed targets
actions.mechanism: Evaluate explicit error handling and preference retention under controlled invalidation, rather than rewarding faster confirmation.
actions.implementation: Inject unavailability at the same review stage, independent of elapsed time. Record silent substitutions, exposed conflicts, retained preferences, and independently completed recovery; impose no countdown.
actions.check: Run untimed keyboard and motor-access trials at 320 pixels; require zero silent substitutions and report recovery failures separately from capacity conflicts.
actions.risk: Controlled trials do not estimate real-world conflict frequency.
